app.learning
~~~~~~~~~~~~~

.. note::
   Not rendered via ``automodule`` — this file is a standalone debug
   script that runs top-level code (including a blocking
   ``matplotlib`` plot) on import rather than being a clean importable
   module. See its module docstring in the source for what it does.
